title: Counit formula for an exceptional Künneth composite
statement:
Fix the global finite-field and coefficient conventions of
[def-trf-coefficient-conventions], with $k=\overline{\mathbf F}_q$ and
$A=A_{E,n}$, $n\geq1$. For $i=1,2$, let $f_i:X_i\to Y_i$ be separated
finite-type morphisms between separated finite-type $k$-schemes, and put
$f=f_1\times_k f_2$. Assume $f_1,f_2,f$ are exceptionally admissible at
$A$, with the specified constructible adjunctions of
[def-trf-admissibility]. Use the finite-Tor categories of
[def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], the geometric operations of
[def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], and the external products of
[def-trf-external-product]. Let $L_i\in D^b_{ctf}(Y_i,A)$ and put
$Q=Rf_1^!L_1\boxtimes_A^LRf_2^!L_2$ and
$L=L_1\boxtimes_A^LL_2$. Let $\alpha:Q\to Rf^!L$ be the specified
exceptional Künneth map of [def-sf-kv-maps] (ii).
For any $P\in D^b_{ctf}(X_1\times_kX_2,A)$ and morphism $e:P\to Q$,
the exceptional adjoint of $\alpha\circ e$ is exactly
$$
Rf_!P\xrightarrow{Rf_!(e)}Rf_!Q
\xrightarrow{\mathrm{Ku}_!}
Rf_{1!}Rf_1^!L_1\boxtimes_A^LRf_{2!}Rf_2^!L_2
\xrightarrow{\varepsilon_{f_1,L_1}\boxtimes\varepsilon_{f_2,L_2}}L.
$$
Here $\mathrm{Ku}_!$ is the compact-support Künneth isomorphism of
[def-sf-kv-maps] (i), and every $\varepsilon$ is the counit of the same
specified geometric constructible adjunction. Equivalently,
$$
\varepsilon_{f,L}\circ Rf_!(\alpha\circ e)
=(\varepsilon_{f_1,L_1}\boxtimes\varepsilon_{f_2,L_2})
\circ\mathrm{Ku}_!\circ Rf_!(e).
$$
The equality is natural under precomposition of $e$ by a morphism in
the stated finite-Tor category.

proof.text:
Unfold clause (ii) of [def-sf-kv-maps] for the specified exceptional adjunctions. It defines $\alpha$ as the exceptional adjoint of the composite
$$Rf_!Q\xrightarrow{\mathrm{Ku}_!}Rf_{1!}Rf_1^!L_1\boxtimes_A^LRf_{2!}Rf_2^!L_2\xrightarrow{\varepsilon_{f_1,L_1}\boxtimes\varepsilon_{f_2,L_2}}L.$$
Equivalently, the adjunction transpose of $\alpha$ is the displayed composite from $Rf_!Q$ to $L$, so
$$\varepsilon_{f,L}\circ Rf_!(\alpha)=(\varepsilon_{f_1,L_1}\boxtimes\varepsilon_{f_2,L_2})\circ\mathrm{Ku}_!.$$
All maps are the specified constructible maps on the finite-Tor categories in the statement.

source.place: clause (ii), displayed exceptional Künneth composite and its exceptional adjoint

proof.text:
For $e:P\to Q$, functoriality of $Rf_!$ and associativity of composition give $Rf_!(\alpha\circ e)=Rf_!(\alpha)\circ Rf_!(e)$. Postcomposing with the counit $\varepsilon_{f,L}$ and substituting Step 1 yields exactly
$$Rf_!P\xrightarrow{Rf_!(e)}Rf_!Q\xrightarrow{\mathrm{Ku}_!}Rf_{1!}Rf_1^!L_1\boxtimes_A^LRf_{2!}Rf_2^!L_2\xrightarrow{\varepsilon_{f_1,L_1}\boxtimes\varepsilon_{f_2,L_2}}L.$$
If $h:P'\to P$ is a further morphism, replacing $e$ by $e\circ h$ gives the same equality with $Rf_!(e)\circ Rf_!(h)=Rf_!(e\circ h)$, proving naturality under precomposition. The functoriality and the counit transpose are those of the specified adjunction $Rf_!\dashv Rf^!$ in [def-trf-admissibility].
